mapper.select: SELECT pi.sku_id AS skuId, p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS productName, poi.qty AS purchaseQty, pi.qty AS qty, pi.sku_spec_snapshot AS skuSpecSnapshot FROM purchase_in_item pi LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON pi.sku_id = ps.id LEFT JOIN product_v2 p ON ps.product_v2_id = p.id LEFT JOIN purchase_order_item poi ON poi.purchase_id = #{purchaseId} AND poi.sku_id = pi.sku_id WHERE pi.in_id = #{inId}
